phase_10_fp_gates.action: Run 5 schema quality checks (adapted FP gates)
checks: Type completeness: All JSON fields represented
Type correctness: Types match JSON (number vs string vs bool)
No loose types: No {...} or [...] without constraints
Consistent naming: Field names match JSON exactly
Documentation: All schemas have descriptive comments

phase_11_qa.method: Run command, capture JSON, validate against schema with CUE

phase_12_mf2.action: Opus final review of all 24 schemas

phase_14_liability.action: Ensure schemas are minimal and well-documented
checks: No over-constrained types that might break on valid inputs

phase_15_landing.commit_message: feat(schemas): Add CUE schemas for all 24 command outputs

success_criteria.primary: All 24 commands have accurate CUE schemas in schema/ai/output/
secondary: Schemas match actual JSON output from commands
Consistent naming and formatting across all files

risk_2.risk: Commands with conditional output (e.g., lint valid vs invalid)
